messages:
Alex Rivera: hey team! first day here, quick Notion q — i can view the 'Team playbooks' but no "Duplicate" option. where are the editable templates supposed to live?
Marta Silva: welcome Alex :tada: the canonical templates are in the Templates library, but some top-level playbooks are locked. which page are you on?
Alex Rivera: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/team-playbooks/data-team-playbook
Ben Owens: that playbook is in read-only mode to avoid accidental edits. i can enable page copying for you or add you to docs-editors. which do you prefer?
Alex Rivera: add me to docs-editors please, so i can fork a PRD template. also, curious: do we have an internal naming convention for moved docs?
Marta Silva: added you. Naming: YYYY-MM-team-shortname, underscore is ok but prefer hyphens. e.g., 2026-04-data-dataset-retention. include an "Owner:" and a 1-line summary at the top.
Alex Rivera: great, thanks. where is the PRD template path? i only see a few items in the left Templates menu.
docs-ops: canonical templates live under /handbook/templates. direct link for PRD: notion://redwood/handbook/templates/product/PRD-core. sidebar only surfaces popular ones.
Alex Rivera: if i duplicate into my workspace and then move to /handbook/drafts, should i open a docs repo PR or tag reviewers in Notion?
Ben Owens: do both — open a short PR in the docs repo with the Notion link (CI checks run), then tag reviewers in Notion for inline feedback.
Alex Rivera: is there a checklist for required sections (security, privacy, infra deps)? don't want to miss review steps.
OnboardBot: Reminder: complete the "New hire docs checklist" at /handbook/onboarding/new-hire-checklist after creating docs. It lists privacy, security contact, reviewer suggestions, and naming rules.
Alex Rivera: last one — if a template needs a new field for our team (e.g., data retention table), what's the preferred path: edit shared template or create a new team-specific template?
Marta Silva: create a team-specific variant in /handbook/templates/data and submit a PR to add it to the central library once reviewers approve. That avoids touching the canonical template until consensus.
Alex Rivera: perfect, that's super helpful. appreciate the fast responses! :raised_hands:
